summary: Minimal, correct fix replacing the `__file__`-based `python -m django` detection with the documented `__main__.__spec__.parent` check, which also generalizes to any `-m pkg` and avoids `__file__` (unset in some environments). This is the canonical, well-reasoned resolution and is safe to merge.

issues.description: Behavior change: previously only `python -m django` was rebuilt; now any `-m pkg` launch is reconstructed with `-m <parent>`. This is the intended improvement and matches the documented `__spec__` semantics, but slightly broadens reload behavior versus the old narrow check.

Comment added is adequate, but does not explicitly note that `__spec__.parent` is empty (falsy) when launched via a directory/zipfile path, which is why the `and __main__.__spec__.parent` guard matters; a one-line note would aid future readers.
